digest.component_or_area: live-DC readiness gate and test harness
propositions: The live-DC readiness gate polls /rest/api/2/serverInfo until 200 but does not verify that required GreenHopper custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are registered, allowing a timing flake where fields are absent immediately after serverInfo returns successfully

The harness survives this defect only because downstream test execution is slow enough for the plugin to register fields before _assert_project_capabilities runs, whereas the probe queries fields one second after serverInfo returns and observes only system fields, exposing the real state

Gerrit 1387 fixed the probe path only by adding field polling to jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py but left the harness conftest on serverInfo polling, creating divergence between two readiness definitions that should be one shared definition
When _assert_project_capabilities detects missing fields, it cannot distinguish 'not registered yet' from 'image does not offer these fields', so a timing flake is misattributed to an image degrade

The fix requires a single shared readiness module with bounded budget and field-inventory verification that both the harness and probe delegate to, plus a test pinning that system-only field inventories are treated as not-ready
